The threshold on all three inputs is 1V, which is higher than the 0.5V every other Moffenzeef module uses. The display carries the prompt DOUBLE-CLICK TO TYPE when empty, and the module prints NO TEXT INPUT and NO CLOCK INPUT on it when either is missing. The text field is part of one display widget, so there is no separate control for it to click. The 1V threshold on all three inputs is the highest in the plugin bar one: the record and play jacks on Tehom, the two mode jacks on INTENSIFIES, the Particles on/off jack and the Tantz clock also read 1V, and the Runner's chorus jack reads 2.5V, while the rest of the plugin reads 0.5V.

Particles.notes: Read from the maker's source at 2.6.1, commit e6a0c67, having first been written from the installed 2.6.1 binary. Particles::process does nothing but drive one lamp; every control is read by ParticlesWidget::step, which draws the animation, so no voltage ranges could be established from the audio thread and none are quoted. The sixteen particle names are read from Particles::Particles. The module has no output ports at all, so it has no family map. The source gives the ranges the binary could not: the five knob CVs add a tenth of the control per volt and are clamped with the knob, and the on/off jack toggles on a rising edge through 1V.
